evidence.reason: revalidated: PR #1488 published fix contains flush() listener throws so ManagedChild close always settles (src/shared/proc.ts), fixing a hanging close when a driver-supplied line listener throws during the final flush. Verified against current origin/main e181cf0e87337992289ed3980c34e0563389648c: the close handler now contains each stream flush independently in try/catch (proc.ts:562-569), folds kept listenerError from collection (L570, contained at L397-404), runs settleClose unconditionally afterwards (L571-579), and emits one process warning for the flush failure (L580-584) - a stronger per-stream realization of the same fix under later refactors. Canonical finding delivered; PR #1488 MERGED with published head ancestor of merge.
